user.title: Add an agent
user.description: One entry per agent. Each run the agent reports is recorded against the harness version it ran under.

data_description.agent: How this agent appears in Home Assistant, for example "Coding agent on the workstation".
data_description.agent_program: Most programs get their harness files picked automatically. GitHub Copilot in VS Code, JetBrains Junie and Other start from a suggested list you confirm in the options.

reconfigure.title: Rename the agent or change its program
reconfigure.description: The webhook and the recorded runs stay with the entry.

data_description.agent_program: Most programs get their harness files picked automatically. GitHub Copilot in VS Code, JetBrains Junie and Other start from a suggested list you confirm in the options.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 200 characters.
error.name_taken: Another agent already uses this name.

abort.already_configured: An agent with this name is already set up.

create_entry.default:
{agent} is set up. Its webhook address, shown only here:

`{webhook_url}`

On the machine the agent runs on, run `python report_run.py --setup` and paste the address when asked. Harness files and the version label are set in this agent's options.

init.title: Settings

data.min_runs: Runs to confirm a harness version

data_description.min_runs: A version's success rate counts as a baseline only after this many runs on it.
data_description.tolerance: How far below the baseline's success rate the current version may sit before the gate reports a regression.
data_description.retention: Older runs are dropped once this many are stored.
data_description.window: The window gate compares the last this many runs with the this many before them, whatever harness versions they used.

harness.name: Harness files
harness.description: Automatic uses the file list for the agent program. Manual replaces it with your own list: files and folders on the agent's machine, relative paths resolved against the project root. Recognised settings files count by their harness keys; other files count byte for byte.

data_description.selection: Automatic is offered for every program except GitHub Copilot in VS Code, JetBrains Junie and Other.
data_description.harness_files: Used when the selection is Manual.
data_description.version_label: Optional prefix for the computed version, such as a git branch. No spaces.

error.harness_files_required: Manual needs at least one harness file.
error.harness_files_invalid: Use at most 100 paths of at most 300 characters each.
error.version_label_invalid: Use a label of at most 40 characters, with no spaces.

record_run.name: Record run
record_run.description: Records one completed run for an agent, against the harness version it used.

harness_version.name: Harness version
harness_version.description: Label or fingerprint of the harness the run used.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: Stable id of a repeatable task, so a task that used to pass can be seen to fail.

task_class.name: Task class
task_class.description: Category of work, for example publish, diagnose, build.

verified.name: Verified
verified.description: The result was verified by effect, not by a green tick.

denials.name: Denials
denials.description: Permission or guard denials the run hit.

denial_classes.name: Denial classes
denial_classes.description: Why the denials happened, as a map of class to count: a classifier rule, a hook, or the person.

interventions.name: Interventions
interventions.description: Times a human had to correct or redirect the run.

set_baseline.name: Set baseline
set_baseline.description: Pins the harness version the current one is measured against. Leave the version empty to unpin and let the best confirmed version be the baseline again.

harness_version.name: Harness version
harness_version.description: A version that has at least one recorded run.

entry_not_found.message: No agent has the config entry id {entry_id}.

not_loaded.message: The agent {agent} is not loaded, so the run cannot be recorded.

unknown_harness.message: No run has been recorded on harness version {version}.

store_unreadable.message: The run log could not be read: {error}

webhook_taken.message: The webhook id is already registered by something else.

harness_regressed.title: {agent}: harness {current} regresses the baseline
harness_regressed.description: The current harness {current} is at {current_rate}% success against the baseline {baseline} at {baseline_rate}%, and {tasks} task(s) the baseline solved now fail. Fix the harness, or pin a different baseline with the set_baseline action if the bar is wrong.

window_regressed.title: {agent}: the last {size} runs regress the {size} before them
window_regressed.description: The last {size} runs passed {rate}% with {denials} denials per 100 tool calls, against {prior_rate}% and {prior_denials} in the {size} before them. Harness versions in the window: {versions}. Recurring denial classes: {recurring}. Find the change among those versions that caused it, then fix or revert it.
